svg.title: Thus the minus sign, joint-test domain and arbitrary strict-cone height direction in (CR2) are recovered before any boundary approach. For the frequency step retain the source’s scaled Schwartz transform H and absolute momentum coordinates q. Put gs = es⟨ey,q⟩g on the same compact support. Recovery commutes with this fixed test operation and its Schwartz derivative. Writing d = ey, the two recovered product-rule terms cancel exactly: d dsΨZ v (sy; H gs) = −Ψv(sy; H (⟨d, q⟩gs))
